{
  "name": "session-todo",
  "version": "0.2.21",
  "description": "A live todo pane for the session: the agent keeps it current through a tool, you read and tick it without asking.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Jesper Sahlin",
    "url": "https://github.com/jepperip"
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "theme": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Theme",
      "description": "How the Todo pane is coloured: classic (the terminal's green, yellow, red), cyberpunk (neon green and purple), or a standard palette.",
      "default": "classic",
      "options": [
        "classic",
        "cyberpunk",
        "dracula",
        "nord",
        "solarized",
        "gruvbox",
        "monokai",
        "catppuccin",
        "tokyo-night",
        "one-dark"
      ]
    },
    "compact": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Compact rows",
      "description": "Drop the blank line between items in the Todo pane.",
      "default": false
    },
    "band": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Band above the prompt",
      "description": "When to show the item in progress and the count in a row above the prompt, with a button that opens the pane: off, closed (only while the Todo pane is closed), or always.",
      "default": "closed",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "closed",
        "always"
      ]
    }
  }
}
